rows.label: tlk70000010_02_msg0001
rows.name:
People say everyone fought
well, but to me, it was
pathetic. No other word for it.

rows.label: tlk70000010_02_msg0002
rows.name:
What I do know is, that I don't
know what would have happened
if you guys weren't here.

rows.label: tlk70000010_02_msg0003
rows.name:
I had to stay here, but I heard Onyx's
squad helped clear rubble and make
repairs.

rows.label: tlk70000010_02_msg0004
rows.name:
I mean, it was by order of the
King. But I still think it's a
pretty nice thing of them to do.

rows.label: tlk70000010_02_msg0005
rows.name:
Usually they just stand about around
the palace, the big meatheads.

rows.label: tlk70000010_02_msg0006
rows.name:
I wonder how Calcedo is doing. I hear
he's well, but I don't want to
interfere too much...
